description: This file contains a unit test class for the EmployeeReportingMethodService in the OrangeHRM project. It sets up test scenarios to verify methods related to employee report-to relationships, including subordinate and supervisor list retrieval, and ID list manipulation.

classes.name: EmployeeReportingMethodServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for EmployeeReportingMethodService, contains multiple test methods verifying subordinate and supervisor retrieval logic and related ID list functions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, creates an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodService, and populates test data from fixture file.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeReportingMethodDao
methods.description: Verifies that the service returns an instance of EmployeeReportingMethodDao.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Tests counting subordinates for an employee via mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetImmediateSupervisorListCountForEmployee
methods.description: Tests counting immediate supervisors for an employee via mocked DAO.

methods.name: testGetSubordinateListForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of subordinate list results, including report-to relationships.

methods.name: testGetImmediateSupervisorListForEmployee
methods.description: Tests retrieval of immediate supervisors list and associated report-to data.

methods.name: testGetAccessibleAndAvailableSupervisorsIdCombinedList
methods.description: Tests merging of accessible supervisor IDs with already assigned IDs, ensuring correct combined list.

methods.name: testGetAlreadyAssignedSupervisorsSubordinatesAndSelfIdCombinedList
methods.description: Verifies concatenation of supervisor IDs, subordinate IDs, and self ID into a single list.
